gloss: to omit writing; to fail to write down; to leave out

definitions.gloss: to omit writing; to fail to write down; to leave out in writing
definitions.explanation: To accidentally fail to include something that should have been written. Implies an unintentional omission rather than a deliberate exclusion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{漏|も}らして⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I had omitted writing the name.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧なこと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{漏|も}らさないよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was careful not to leave out anything important.

examples.japanese: ⟦{報告書|ほうこくしょ}→報告書：06744_houkokusho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{数字|すうじ}→数字：03361_suuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ひとつ{書|か}き{漏|も}らしたせい⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、やり{直|なお}しになった。
examples.english: Because I left out one number in the report, I had to redo it.

notes:
A compound verb from ⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (to write) + ⟦{漏|も}らす→漏らす：02436_morasu⟧ (to let leak, to miss). Transitive. Describes the accidental omission of something in writing. The auxiliary ⟦{漏|も}らす→漏らす：02436_morasu⟧ adds the meaning of 'failing to do' or 'letting slip through' when attached to verb stems.

TRANSITIVITY: transitive

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {書|か}き{漏|も}らし⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: there is an omission in the writing
- {書|か}き{漏|も}らさないよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: so as not to leave anything out
- ⟦うっかり→うっかり：01863_ukkari⟧{書|か}き{漏|も}らす: to accidentally omit writing

SIMILAR PATTERNS WITH {漏|も}らす:
- {聞|き}き{漏|も}らす: to fail to hear, to miss hearing
- {言|い}い{漏|も}らす: to fail to mention, to leave unsaid
- {見|み}{漏|も}らす: to fail to notice, to overlook

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{書|か}き{忘|わす}れる→書き忘れる：28241_kakiwasureru⟧: to forget to write -- emphasis on forgetting rather than accidentally omitting
- {書|か}き{落|お}とす: to leave out in writing -- very similar, slightly more formal
